dog.description_text:
AGE / WEIGHT: 2 years old / 38 lbs

GENDER: Female

ENERGY: Moderate

GOOD WITH: Dogs - Yes, Kids - TBD, Cats - TBD

ABOUT ME: Everybody gets excited about Friday, but honestly? I'm more excited about you. I walked out of my kennel nice and easy, and a few minutes later I was belly-up for someone I'd just met. My owner left me boarding in Georgia and said she'd be back. She wasn't. No hard feelings; I'm just holding out for someone who shows up. Calm dogs? We can hang. Loud ones? I'll pass. You, though? Instant hit.

MY FOSTER SAYS: I will arrive in Brooklyn soon! Badass will share more as soon as I’m in a foster home.

HISTORY

Rebecca Black was abandoned by her owner when they moved out of town and has been in the care of our Georgia rescue partner ever since. Rebecca will travel to Brooklyn in mid-October 2026.

DETAILED PROFILE

We will provide a more detailed profile for Rebecca Black once we get to know more about her!

MEDICAL HISTORY

The dogs in our care are up-to-date on vaccinations, spayed or neutered (when old enough), microchipped, and given a general health check. Immediate medical needs and medical history will be addressed with the adopter prior to adoption. Complete vet records will be sent shortly after adoption.
dog.name: Rebecca Black
